name: Os Esquilos: the forest farmhouse

looks.night: after sunset in Rio until sunrise (rain at night shows night)

states.start: a quiet weekday: the colonial house and its veranda with one family at a dark wooden table, the east table empty, the little white table by the door, the ornate parasol over an empty table in the stone courtyard, smoke from the wood stove, one squirrel
states.full: the Sunday feast: the veranda crowded, every parasol table taken, the feast table under its parasol and the lanterns with the five friends at it, the roast and the cake, garlands, the band (viola, accordion, pandeiro), squirrels and birds

state_note: both states share every fixed thing (house, veranda, courtyard, the ornate parasol, trees), so the swap never moves a slot. Suggested switch to 'full': on a Sunday after the fifth whole goal, or for the day of any whole goal (the feast).

celebrations.what: the long feast table in the courtyard under a big cream parasol, laid with a white lace cloth, plates and cups for the friends, and Esme's chair at its head
strings of little paper lanterns across the courtyard, from the columns to the poles and the trees
flower garlands along the veranda eave and posies and hydrangea vases on the feast table
the Sunday roast (a golden leitão) and clay pots of food on the feast table
a big white cake with candles at the head of the table, by Esme's chair

celebration_rule: Each WHOLE goal finished lays the next celebration piece, in order (1 feast table, 2 lanterns, 3 flowers and mementos, 4 the roast, 5 the cake), in BOTH scenes, and puts its goal sticker in the next free goal slot (lowest 'order'). Draw the start base, then celebration layers 1..n for the current look (each layer holds only the pixels it changes). After the fifth goal the feast is fully laid; goals 6+ only add stickers. 'full' (the Sunday feast) already contains all five pieces plus the crowd, the friends at the feast table and the band.
foot: x, y = bottom-centre pixel of the 16x16 sticker; draw at left = x - 8, top = y - 15
draw_order: base, celebration layers in order, then stickers sorted by foot y (then x), then the rain overlay
sticker_looks: recolour placed stickers by colour name with palette-rain.json ('rain') or palette-night.json ('night') so they match the base
